events.title: The "Scourge Realms" Demo is Live!
events.summary: The time has come! The demo for Scourge Realms is now live.13 unique skills present in demo (you can re-spec anytime).Various enchantments to augment and empower your build with.2 difficulty tiers to complete.3 realms to traverse and slay scourge in.Plenty of treasures to be found!An In game guide menu to help you get started.Gameplay/quality of life improvements (improved from playtest build).I hope the demo experience is enjoyable, and thanks to all who gives this project a chance.Game balance

events.title: Progression Overview & Upcoming Playtest | Development Update #1
events.summary: Hello all, This is the first development update for "Scourge Realms", and I have quite a bit to share.PROGRESSION "Scourge Realms" is an Action RPG at its core that borrows some gameplay features of roguelikes. Each run will start fresh and challenges will vary with each run. What will not vary is your progression. All of your xp, loot, crafting materials will be persistent in-between runs, allowing you to build up a strong character capable of clearing harder but more rewarding content.THE HOME
